segments.en: of Eisov. A sign of this  (Hosea 2:1):  "And the number of the children of Israel will be as the sand of the sea." (the initia ls  of the last four words  spell out the word  'bichiya' - crying ) .

segments.he:
ב.

נוֹצָה שֶׁ ל עוֹפוֹת הַבַּר הֵם סְגֻלָּה ל ְ חֳלָאֵי הָרֵאָה, וּמְסֻגָּל לְחַזֵּק אֶת הָרוּחַ־חַיִּים.
segments.en: One who does not look upon women, merits that his descendants will author commentaries on the Torah.

segments.he:
ג.

הַשָּׁמַיִם – יֵשׁ בָּהֶם שִׁנּוּי מַרְאוֹת לְפִי מַרְאוֹת עֲשָׂבִים הַנִּגְדָּלִים עַל־יְדֵיהֶם, וְהֵם מְסֻגָּלִים לְהִסְתַּכֵּל בָּהֶן.
segments.en: That which holy books by  T zaddikim  are buried  (respectfully) , and lost, and forgotten from the world, as with several books of the Tanaim and early Torah sages, which were lost and forgotten, this is beneficial for the world, for through this, many books by heretics and blasphemers, may their names be blotted out, are lost, uprooted and erased. Also, through this is annulled jealousy and hatred  (existing)  between an upright couple who live in holiness.

segments.he:
ד.

מֵי גְּשָׁמִים מְסֻגָּלִין לְמִי שֶׁאֵין לוֹ גְּבוּרַת אֲנָשִׁים.
segments.en: Through a significant book that comes into the world, barren women conceive. A hint for this  (Genesis 5:1):  "This is the book of the offspring of man."

segments.he:
ה.

אֲמִירַת תְּהִלִּים סְגֻלָּה לְהוֹרִיד גְּשָׁמִים "תְּהִלִּם" – לִ'מְטַר הַ'שָּׁמַיִם תִּ'שְׁתֶּה מָ'יִם.
segments.en: (An auspicious action or object)

segments.he:
ו.

סְגֻלָּה לְהַחֲזִיר לְאִשָּׁה ו ֶ סְתָּהּ עַל־יְדֵי הַכְנָסַת אוֹרְחִים.
segments.en: SECOND PART:

segments.he:
ז.

מִי שֶׁשַּׂעֲרוֹתָיו מְרֻבִּים שֶׁלֹּא עַל־פִּי הַטֶּבַע, זֶה עָלוּל לִנְזָקִים הַרְבֵּה וְלִפ ְגָעִים רָעִים מֵהַסִּטְרָא־אַח ֲ רָא, סְגֻלָּתוֹ שֶׁיִּקְרָא הַפָּרָשָׁה שֶׁקּוֹרִין בְּיוֹם־כִּפּוּרִים.
segments.en: Feathers from wild birds are a  segulah for healing sicknesses of the lungs, and are conducive to strengthening the breath of life.

segments.he:
ח.

מִי שֶׁנִּתְאַלֵּם בְּפֶתַע פּ ִתְאוֹם, יַעֲבִירוּ עַל פִּיו ח ַ ל ָ ף כָּשֵׁר.
segments.en: The heavens have changes in their appearance according to the appearance of the grasses that grow by them, and it is effective to gaze on them.

segments.he:
ט.

סְגֻלָּה לְמַקְשָׁה לֵילֵד, תִּתְלֶה לָהּ עַל צַוָּארָהּ מַפְתֵּחַ שֶׁל הַבֵּית־עָלְמִין. גַּם הַמַּפְתֵּחַ הַזֶּה מְסֻגָּל לַעֲקָרָה.
segments.en: Rainwater is a  segulah for an impotent male.

segments.he:
י.

סְגֻלָּה ל ְ חֳלִי הַצַּוָּאר, שֶׁיִּבְכֶּה עַל חֻרְבַּן בֵּית־הַמִּקְדָּשׁ.
segments.en: Recital of  Tehillim (Psalms)  is a  segulah for rainfall. [The letters of the word]  Tehillim [are the acronym for the Biblical phrase]  - "According to the Rains of the Heavens, You will drink Water."

segments.he:
יא.

סְגֻלָּה כְּשֶׁנִּכְנָס לְבַיִת חָדָשׁ לָגוּר, יַכְנִיס לְשָׁם חֶרֶב אוֹ סַכִּין אוֹ שְׁאָר כְּלֵי־זַיִן. וְסִימָן לַדָּבָר: בְּחָכְמָה יִבָּנֶה בָּיִת – כְּ'לֵי חָ'מָס מְ'כֵרוֹתֵיהֶם; חַרְבוֹתֵיהֶם מְגוּרוֹתֵיהֶם.
segments.en: A  segulah for renewing a woman's monthly cycle is to host guests.

Someone whose h air is unnaturally abundant, is  liable to  much  damage and  bad calamities  from the Other Side. A  segulah against this is reciting the section  (of the Torah reading)  that is read on  Yom Kippur .

segments.he:
יג.

סְגֻלָּה לְחוֹלֶה – לְהִסְתַּכֵּל עַל הַצִּיצִית. (וְהַסּוֹד בַּפָּסוּק: "הִנֵּה בִּנְךָ יוֹסֵף בָּא אֵלֶיךָ", כִּי כָּל אֵלּוּ הַתֵּבוֹת מְרַמְּזִין עַל הַצִּיצִית, הַיְנוּ מִנְיַן הַחוּטִין וְהַחֻלְיוֹת וְהַקְּשָׁרִים כְּמוֹ שֶּׁמְּבֹאָר בִּפְרִי־עֵץ־חַיִּים, עַיֵּין שָׁם, וְעַל־יְדֵי זֶה: "וַיִתְחַזֵּק יִשְׂרָאֵל"). וְעַיֵּן בְּלִקּוּטֵ י מוֹהֲרַ"ן חֵלֶק א' סִימָן ז.
segments.en: Someone who becomes mute suddenly and unexpectedly, should pass a kosher butcher's knife over his mouth.

segments.he:
יד.

סְגֻלָּה לְחוֹלֶה נוֹפֵל – שֶׁיְּפַזֵּר צְדָקָה. פִּ'זַּר נָ'תַן לָ'אֶבְיוֹנִים  (לִקּוּטֵי מוֹ הֲרַ"ן כט) .
segments.en: A  segulah for a woman having difficulty giving birth is to hang the key to the cemetery upon her neck. Also, this key is a  segula h  for a barren woman.

segments.he:
טו.

סְגֻלָּה לְמַקְשָׁה לֵילֵד, שֶׁתִּרְחַץ בְּיַיִן מִלְּפָנֶיהָ וּמֵאֲחוֹרֶיהָ; נִכְנָס יַיִן יָצָא סוֹד.
segments.en: It is a  segulah for one suffering illness in the neck, to weep over the destruction of the Temple.

Upon entering a new house in which to live, it is a  segulah to bring in a sword, knife or other weapon. An indication for this (from Scripture): "Through wisdom a house is built"  (Proverbs 24:3) ,  the letters of "wisdom" (ChuChMah) stand for "Weapons  (Clee) of Violence (Chummus)  they practice where they Reside (Michairoasayhem)  (Bereshit 49:5)". Their swords, their residence  (the Hebrew word in the verse which was translated as “their residence” can be alternately translated: "their swords" (in which case the “weapons of violence” would be translated as, stolen weapons, see Rashi there)) . [t.n. Thus a connection between weapons and the maintaining of residence can be established].
Apples are a  segulah for one who has difficulties in childbirth.

12 .  It is beneficial  (a segula) for a sick person to look upon the  tzitzis (fringes).  [This secret is (found) in the verse (Beraishis 48:2), “behold, your son Yosef has come to see you.” For all these words allude to the  tzitzis ; i.e. to the number of the strings, and the chulyos (stitches), and the knots, as is explained in  Pri Eitz Chaim  (Fruit of the Tree of Life – a Kabalistic work of the Arizal) see there, and through this (the end of the verse), “and Israel strengthened himself”}.  See also LM I: 7.
It is beneficial for an epileptic ,  to distribute money to charity.
It is beneficial  (a segula) for a woman having difficulty giving b irth, for her to wash with wine, her front and  her back; 'when wine enters,  secrets come out.' (Eruvin 65a)
